title: WAPC approval of lots up to 5% below Table 3B minimum and/or average site area
text: The WAPC, in consultation with the local government, may approve the creation of a green title lot or survey-strata lot (excluding battleaxe lots) with a minimum and/or average site area up to 5 per cent less than that specified in Table 3B where it will: i. not create more than one lot with a reduced minimum lots size; ii. facilitate the protection of an environmental or heritage feature; iii. facilitate the retention of a significant element that contributes toward an existing streetscape worthy of retention; iv. facilitate the development of lots with separate and sufficient frontage to more than one public street; v. overcome a special or unusual limitation on the development of the land imposed by its size, shape or other feature; vi. allow land to be developed with housing of the same type and form as land in the vicinity and which would not otherwise be able to be developed; or vii. achieve specific objectives of the local planning framework.

replaces.note: adds (i) no more than one lot with a reduced minimum; excludes battleaxe lots; strata lots dropped

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

verified.note: Text checked. The pink callout (local governments to approve up-to-5% variations through a development approval) is a potential change only.

notes: Same as the Chapter 2 twin with Table 3B for Table 2B (p51). WAPC discretion, not an applicant test. Strata lots dropped and battleaxe lots excluded (not in the ToC); item (i) sits in an 'or' list so reads as an alternative. Pink callout: local governments may approve up-to-5% variations through a development approval (flagged only).
